task: single-turn e-commerce customer service dialogues (system, user, assistant)
acquire: download the three splits from dataset_url into a local directory, then pass one split to scripts/finetune_embedder.py --corpus <split>.jsonl; the sha256 above is what that run records
used_for: training pairs only: user messages become anchors, policy sections become positives
not_used_for: no evaluation case is sampled from this corpus; retrieval and intent labels are authored in evals/retrieval/gold_cases.json and evals/intent/, and the corpus answers and dialogue labels are never imported
rows_note: 246,125 rows in total; 85,298 distinct user messages of 4-40 characters remain after whitespace normalisation, de-duplication and dropping messages that carry 8+ digit runs or URLs
